address: HIPAA, SOC 2 Type 2, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001 compliant

reading.body:
The EdgeConneX Portland campus sits on 18,700 square feet of technical space in Hillsboro, Oregon. No IT load figure in megawatts is published on the operator's spec page, so no rack or accelerator count can be derived here. Without a power figure, the campus cannot be ranked among the six Oregon facilities this site has read that do publish megawatt figures, and it falls outside the 182 MW total those six represent. It is one of 133 mapped facilities in Oregon, most of which also publish no power figure.

The four certifications qualify this campus for distinct workload categories. SOC 2 Type 2 qualifies it for customers with audit requirements around security controls. PCI DSS qualifies it for payment card data processing. HIPAA qualifies it for regulated health information. ISO 27001 qualifies it for customers whose contracts require that international information security management standard. Which tenants or workloads are actually present is not published.

For a reader evaluating AI relevance, the absence of a published power figure is the central fact. AI training and large inference workloads are selected primarily on available megawatts and power density, neither of which this campus has disclosed. The compliance stack, particularly SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001, is consistent with enterprise AI inference or data pipeline work where regulatory posture matters alongside compute, but the campus cannot be assessed on raw scale without a power number. That number is not published.
